state.title: sleep 130 && echo SLEPT_OK

reasoning_details.text:
The user wants me to run a command that sleeps for 130 seconds and then echoes "SLEPT_OK". They want me to run it exactly once with no timeout argument. The default timeout for bash commands is 120000ms (120 seconds), so this command would timeout since sleep 130 > 120 seconds.

Let me run it and see what happens.

```
shell tool terminated command after exceeding timeout 120000 ms. If this command is expected to take longer and is not waiting for interactive input, retry with a larger timeout value in milliseconds.
```
